svg.font-family: 'STIX Two Text','STIX Two Math','Times New Roman',serif
svg.title: Spatial-stochastic blastocyst cavity model
svg.desc: Schematic. A: fixed ICM cell compartments above the blastocyst cavity, surrounded by the trophectoderm. B: NANOG and GATA6 each activate their own gene and repress the other's; NANOG activates and GATA6 represses Fgf4 expression; secreted FGF4 activates FGFR and ERK in the same or a neighboring cell; activated ERK activates Gata6, represses Nanog and phosphorylates NANOG; phosphorylated NANOG is dephosphorylated or degraded faster. C: the cavity and TE are effective extracellular reservoirs that exchange FGF4 with the ICM and with each other and lose it by degradation.
svg.text: Fixed ICM cells; no cell movement or division
N: NANOG · G: GATA6 · NP: phosphorylated NANOG · EA: activated ERK
Cavity and TE: effective extracellular reservoirs
Cavity-associated FGF4 and TE-associated transport provide
a spatial signaling hypothesis tested by the model.
